decisions.story_title: Supply Chain Worm Compromises npm TanStack Query Code Generator Package
decisions.reason: Real supply chain attack: 10 malicious versions of a 150K/week npm package published in 20 minutes, stealing developer credentials and poisoning repos. GitHub Actions workflow compromise bypasses provenance attestations.

decisions.story_title: Gogs Path Traversal CVE-2026-52813 Enables Authenticated RCE via Git Hooks
decisions.reason: Critical CVE in Gogs: path traversal via unsanitized org usernames in API allows planting malicious Git hooks for remote code execution. Fixed in 0.14.3.
Same TerminalFix/ClickFix campaign already tracked in existing story. Covers fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA -> PowerShell -> DLL sideloading -> reverse tunnel implant.

decisions.story_title: TA4922 Deploys PackClient RAT via Tax-Themed Phishing in Asia
decisions.reason: Real APT campaign: Chinese-speaking TA4922 uses tax inspection lures to deploy PackClient RAT framework targeting China and India. Proofpoint research, modular malware with data theft, surveillance, and persistence.
Microsoft's own report on the same TerminalFix campaign. Canonical source; already in this story.
